summary.t: 3D Christmas Tree with pinecone - Merry Christmas

text.t:
Simple, delicate and full of charm, this Christmas tree is made from white lacquered plywood, featuring the message Merry Christmas and a beautiful suspended 3D pinecone, which gives it a special and original touch.
With a natural cord for hanging, it combines the elegance of white with the simplicity of natural details, creating a cosy and timeless Christmas decoration.
Perfect for decorating the Christmas tree, embellishing a special corner of your home or giving to someone dear.

gpsr.warnings.0.t: This is an ornament and not a toy: hang it out of reach of young children, who may put it in their mouths.
